verdict.rationale: The evidence documents managing upgrades, downgrades and seat-quantity changes, but none of it mentions proration, partial-period credits, or prorated invoice line items. The only timing detail given is that price changes bill at the start of the next billing period. Lifecycle management without documented proration math is an adjacent capability, not this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, mid-cycle upgrades and downgrades are prorated with documented, auditable math — credits, partial periods, and invoice line items that reconcile to the penny
